# KayKit Dungeon Remastered — Selected Meshes

**Author:** Kay Lousberg (KayKit)

**Original GitHub repository:** https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0

**Updated official pack:** https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-dungeon-pack

**Licence:** Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0); see included LICENSE.txt.

**Imported:** floor_tile_large, floor_tile_large_rocks, wall, wall_doorway, pillar, chest, chest_gold, torch_lit, barrel_small, stairs_wide, rubble_half. OBJ mesh vertices/UVs and geometry are copied from the official KayKit-Game-Assets repository. Only per-object `mtllib` and `usemtl` OBJ declarations were removed: an individual shared texture atlas PNG cannot be transferred through the current text-only repository integration, so Outpost supplies simple original Material3D tint/roughness fallbacks. These imported pieces are genuine KayKit geometry, not re-creations or Albion assets.

An atlas import remains an art-polish follow-up; avoid claiming the textured full 1.1 asset pack is bundled.
